meta.title: Yuzheng Sun / 课代表立正 public profile facts
meta.scope: Public, reusable records. Identity, career, metrics, current work, initiatives, books, and links are factual or current-state records; dated_judgments preserve claims made at the time; endorsements are third-party quotations; outcomes are bounded case records. Volatile metrics require date checks.

identity.core_proposition_en: People should have the chance to make work whose value outlives the moment of making and bears the mark of the maker's distinctive judgment and craft.
identity.core_proposition_zh: 一个人应该有机会把自己的判断和本事，做成价值能够超越制作与首次发布的当下、也清楚承载自己独特判断与手艺的作品。
identity.intellectual_spine_en: A defining work turns hard-won understanding and lived craft into responsible authorship—and remains answerable to reality, time, and the people it serves.
identity.intellectual_spine_zh: 代表作，是把逐渐挣来的理解与手艺，做成自己愿意长期负责、世界也愿意继续选择的作品。
identity.ai_era_content_thesis_en: As AI gets better at answering, people have to get better at deciding what is worth asking and what should count as useful.
identity.ai_era_content_thesis_zh: AI越会做题，人越要会出题。
identity.founder_brand_relationship_en: Yuzheng is the author, practitioner, and public representative of this belief. Superlinear is both the defining work he is pursuing through long-term practice and the institution he is building to help other people pursue defining work of their own.
identity.founder_brand_relationship_zh: 立正是这套信念的提出者、实践者和公共代表。Superlinear既是他正在用长期实践追求的代表作，也是他为更多人追求自己的代表作而建立的长期机构。
representation_guidance: Canonical career records retain the official title and chronology. Formal resumes, structured data, employment verification, and detailed factual profiles normally use those exact records.

Headlines, social profiles, spoken introductions, and short bios may use familiar industry shorthand when it does not materially overstate the employer relationship, actual responsibility, or outcome. For example, 腾讯总监 can compress the official Vice Director, Data & AI title in a short Chinese profile without replacing the canonical record.

Statsig was acquired by OpenAI after Yuzheng had left. OpenAI收购团队早期成员 is accepted shorthand for that high-information company context on Chinese audience-facing surfaces, including bios, collaboration pages, and host kits. Formal résumés, structured records, and factual source pages keep the Statsig name and chronology. The shorthand does not itself say Yuzheng worked at OpenAI and should not be expanded into former OpenAI, OpenAI alum, or a claim that he personally participated in, led, caused, or predicted the acquisition.

For founder, investor, technical, and product audiences, the Statsig role together with the company's later acquisition by OpenAI can be a high-information signal. In a tight introduction, it may be more useful than mechanically naming every employer, while the chronology and employment boundary above still apply.

Only material labeled verbatim, or high-risk wording such as promises, disputes, legal or safety claims, normally requires word-for-word matching. Ordinary media quotations may remove fillers, repetition, or obvious grammatical slips and may be translated when meaning and tone remain faithful. Mark meaningful edits or translations; use unquoted paraphrase for substantive rewriting, and never invent a view or endorsement.
These are defaults for owned media. When an external publisher or collaborator has a known house style or approval process, adapt to it unless that would create a material falsehood.

dated_judgments.topic: Limits and useful applications of the dominant AI paradigm
dated_judgments.claim: Systems that learn mappings from labeled data can automate narrow settings well without acquiring general understanding; useful AI applications should be chosen from the mechanism and task structure rather than benchmark spectacle or hype.
dated_judgments.context: Two public videos before ChatGPT established the prior explanatory model later revised in the February 2023 essay.

dated_judgments.claim: ChatGPT was a new natural-language interface to data and computation, not merely a better chatbot. The pre-GPT-4 version reasoned forward to lower inference cost, persistent memory and personalization, tool-connected workflows, direct result delivery, and ChatGPT-native systems.
dated_judgments.context: First written in February 2023 and publicly archived by 2023-03-06, before GPT-4. The original text supports mechanisms later called agentic but did not use agent as its organizing term. Private search and the Microsoft 365 Copilot section were later additions and are not part of the pre-GPT-4 evidence.
dated_judgments.later_review: The living article preserves the original probabilities and records two major errors: underweighting human and organizational factors at OpenAI, and overestimating the near-term speed and headroom of model-training progress.

dated_judgments.claim: The most important near-term shift in AI, with a meaningful 10–18 month opportunity window.
Major structural flaws; the hype exceeded what the protocol could reliably deliver.
The product category would not last, although trying it remained useful for understanding the capability shift.
